summary: Independently attacked the 149O.20L.7O.2S.2 implementation of FGSC-001 v1.0 (contract frozen by 2S, verified with 0 blocking findings by 2S.1) using a fresh, self-contained 9-test suite (tests/test_phase_149o_20l_7o_2s_3_fgsc_001_lifecycle_independent_verification.py) plus direct source and call-graph inspection -- no production/existing-test change. Path classification (contract Section 4) was independently reconstructed from classify_finalization_path() and confirmed exact under real (not synthetic-mode-string) attacks: chmod +x mode-only diff, real `ln -s` symlink, real Git gitlink entry under an otherwise-open directory, and rename in both directions (unsafe-to-safe and safe-to-unsafe), all end-to-end through check_finalization_delta(). Merge-commit rejection and history-rewrite/ancestry rejection (2S.2 suite) were re-run and held. Stage B recursion safety was independently traced by grep across pcae.core.check/status/tasks -- confirmed none imports validate_derived_correctness or finalization_transaction, call graph terminates. The push trust boundary (contract Section 17) was confirmed by direct grep of src/pcae/commands/push.py -- zero fgsc/attribution awareness. BLOCKING FINDING: the staleness carve-out inside validate_derived_correctness() is unsound. It treats 'validate_structured_fast_green() reported staleness as its sole issue' as proof the evidence has no other defect, but validate_structured_fast_green() contains a pre-existing (2R-era, unmodified by this phase or by 2S.2) early return ('if issues: return issues') positioned before the independent recomputation of attributable_failures -- the one check 2Q.1 designed specifically so 'no human/agent judgment call is permitted' and the artifact's own bucket labels are never trusted. Because routine, contract-permitted finalization commits always produce staleness -- that is the entire premise FGSC-001 exists to forgive -- this recomputation is never reached in the normal operating case. Reproduced mechanically: a genuine unclassified failing node injected into a digest-re-signed, otherwise-valid evidence artifact is correctly caught by validate_structured_fast_green() when the checkpoint still equals current HEAD, but silently vanishes from the returned issue list -- and the report is certified FINALIZATION_VERIFIED with issues == [] -- the moment one ordinary Class-B finalization commit advances HEAD past the checkpoint. Verdict C: NOT VERIFIED -- STALENESS CARVE-OUT DEFECT. Real S22.1/S22.2 self-hosting acceptance must not proceed until a future governed repair phase closes this gap and passes fresh independent verification. N1/N2/N3 and 2R.1's four carried-forward findings were independently re-examined against the 2S.2 diff, confirmed unworsened, and not repaired, per phase scope.
